scope: Full critical-apex lemma for the actual canonical critical graphon and its pushforward triangle law: parameter-domain membership, the exact multiplier, support endpoint strictly below a*, all five relaxed-law constraints, zero Hoeffding expectation, and the universal certificate identity Psi(P1)+3 Psi(P2)=0. The law is constructed directly from the proved pointwise Euler equation and constant vertex-entropy rows; no unrestricted critical-minimizer hypothesis is used. Exact cancellation is proved for each of the twelve features and for both Hoeffding contact values. The certificate identity holds even for all real lambda.
